brief:
Shehab Wire reports that Al-Haris, a platform affiliated with resistance security forces, announced Tuesday the foiling of a major hostile operation. The platform said the attack targeted a senior leadership figure in Gaza Strip.

According to the announcement, occupation forces succeeded in abducting a security official who was present during the incident. Additional details about the operation and the circumstances of the abduction remained unclear from the initial statement.
